title: VDS HEARTBEAT (Lo-Fi House Lullaby) [108]
style: lo-fi house meets downtempo, 108 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), bilingual chop weave English + Italian + te reo Maori, dusty filtered kick in heartbeat pattern, vinyl crackle and tape hiss, soft Rhodes chord stabs, warm analog sub bass, jazzy muted guitar plucks, brushed snares, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, server-room-pulse mood intimate and warm, sidechain ducking pads to kick, late-night home-listening 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(vinyl crackle, Rhodes chord, soft pad)
(VDS... heart... beat...)
(bat... ti... to... bat... ti... to...)
(ngā... kau... ngā... kau...)

[Build]
(heartbeat kick locks in, sub bass rises)
VDS! VDS! HEART — BEAT!
BAT — TI — TO! BAT — TI — TO!
NGĀ — KAU! NGĀ — KAU!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(brushed snare roll, soft riser)

[Drop 1]
(four-on-the-floor with heartbeat ghost, dusty kick)
HEART — BEAT!
BAT — TI — TO!
NGĀ — KAU!
VDS — PULSE!
(chop stack +7) si-si-yes-yes / ae-ae-si-si
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(half-time groove, muted guitar plucks, chops trade)
(alive?) (vivo?) (ora?)
(vivo!) (alive!) (ora!)
(e ora ana?) (e ora!) (haere!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE PULSE —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to Rhodes + heartbeat kick alone)
(whispered) vds... heart... beat...
(soft) battito... battito...
(soft) ngā... kau...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(brushed snare builds)

[Drop 2]
(full warm stack, sub doubled)
VDS — HEART — BEAT! (battito battito!)
NGĀ — KAU! (e ora! e ora!)
VI — VO! A — LIVE!
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(heartbeat slows, Rhodes resolves)
(vds... heart... beat...)
(battito... battito...)
(ngā... kau...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(vinyl crackle holds, fade)
